# ADR 0004: Validate check digits before trusting any LEI

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** KYB legal entity lookup service

## Context

Typos in LEIs are common in payment messages.

## Decision

Implement ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 validation and report invalid records instead of loading them.

## Consequences

Catches typos early; cheap.

## Alternatives considered

Trusting input and failing lookups later.
